description: Credits (business template), the administration side: action "adjust" { owner, kind?, delta } (a refund by hand, a gift; never below 0). Credit kinds and the products that top them up: neblla_update_app({ business: { credits: { <kind>: { products: { <productId>: n } } } } }). The actions that only look (balance) are in neblla_credits_read.

env.description: "pro" (the published app) or "pre" (its test copy: pre's config, on pre's data, its own unless it plays with pro's). Left out: where the app is, its chosen environment (neblla_promote "status": target, "pro" by default). The pre id (_<id>) as appId is the same as env "pre"

owner.description: The user id in the app
